name: Production Parking Orchestrator
tagline: Operate a production facility through overlapping failures.
brief: Submit one safe, fair policy for mixed traffic, incidents, and long-running load.
context: The facility chooses an exact bay inside your selected category; your policy controls service order, category, waiting, and exits.
narrative:
You are building the scheduling layer for an airport parking platform. Multiple zones share movement lanes and exit infrastructure.

Arrivals, departures, closures, charging outages, gate failures, reservation changes, cancellations, and recovery can happen together. A bay may close while a car is travelling to it, so the controller must remain safe and continue making progress without assuming a fixed layout or queue size.
objective: Maximise safe completed departures while minimising abandonment, preference loss, queue growth, rerouting, congestion, and operating penalty.
learningObjective: Engineer a durable real-time policy with back-pressure, fairness, failure recovery, and consistent long-running state.
intelligenceExplanation:
No complete starter policy is supplied. Build the decision flow from the operational contract.

The hidden evaluator changes layouts and event timing, but the meanings of facts and actions stay the same. General rules are required; assumptions about one layout are not safe.
hint: Build three layers: hard safety, urgency and fairness, then optimisation preferences. A preference must never bypass eligibility.
hints: Exact bays are selected by the facility allocator; your policy chooses an eligible category and when to consume lane capacity.
Prioritize exit recovery when occupied capacity is the bottleneck, but do not ignore a near-expiry entrance vehicle.
A final hold branch is necessary because physical work, failures, and recovery continue between decisions.

steps.label: Encode the hard safety and compatibility envelope
Balance exit recovery, priority, and starvation prevention
Remain stable through overlapping closures and gate failures
Submit against the production hidden evaluation suite

objectives.label: Resolve the complete visible production stream
Keep visible abandonment below five vehicles

goals.description: Operate safely through continuous production incidents.

functions.description: Assign to the matching reserved bay.
Start a ready vehicle's physical exit.
Let facility work advance without starting another action.
